title: WASTELIGHT / SALVAGED FLEX LAMP
core_formula: ordinary / discarded components -> minimal intervention -> new luminous form -> collectible object
core_lesson: DON'T OVERDESIGN THE PARTS - RECOMPOSE THEM INTO A NEW PRESENCE.
summary: A used corrugated hose and simple light strip become a sculptural light object through insertion, hand shaping and internal glow.
learn: Strong objects do not always require complex engineering.
Find a good union between two ordinary parts and change their roles.
Let light reveal form from within instead of acting as decoration.
avoid: dusty brown/orange atmosphere as style rule
